name: Leapsome
what: People-enablement platform: performance reviews, engagement surveys, goals/OKRs, learning, compensation, and more recently HRIS and payroll.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); press and the company's own quote name Visionaries Club in the March 2022 Series A (Leapsome's first outside capital); the Growth Fund I register page lists Leapsome GmbH among its 2022 shareholdings.
membership.quote: Insight Partners led the round, with Creandum and Visionaries Club also participating.

entry.quote: Leapsome has completed a Series A financing round amounting to 60 million US dollars.

valuation.quote: No priced valuation published for the Series A.

notes: The $60M Series A was Leapsome's first outside round ('the first time the start-up has received outside capital - previously it had been financed exclusively via bootstrapping', Startbase 2022-03-24), so it is Visionaries' entry. The vehicle is Growth Fund I: the Growth Fund I (HRA 55965 B) North Data page lists 'Leapsome GmbH' among its 2022 shareholdings (sources/registers). Leapsome's own announcement post (leapsome.com/blog/leapsome-60-million-series-a) now returns 404, so the Startbase copy is cited; the date is Startbase's (the round was announced around 22-24 March 2022). No later round found (googlenews '"Leapsome" raises' and '"Leapsome" before:2022-12-31': product and hiring news only through July 2026). HQ Berlin (site footer lists New York and Berlin addresses: Brunnenstr. 153, 10115 Berlin); agrees with Creandum and Insight siblings. Co-founder Jenny von Podewils is a Visionaries founder-LP (TechCrunch 2022-09-22), which does not affect the fund position. WebSearch used once.
